meaning.en: a movable frame of woven branches used as a barrier
meaning.zh: 用编织树枝制成的活动篱笆或栏障

source.note: Etymonline analyzes hyrdel as a diminutive of hyrd (door), with an earlier Germanic sense of a wickerwork frame. Keep modern hurdle as the surface stem; the historical diminutive is explained here rather than linked to the unrelated Latin diminutive root:le. Sources: https://www.etymonline.com/word/hurdle ; https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hurdle .

meaning.en: barrier; obstacle to jump over or overcome
meaning.zh: 栏障；待跨越或克服的障碍

learning.coreImage: 一道编枝篱笆挡在前面；跑者把它跨过去。
learning.notes: 现代 hurdle 是不可再作实用拆分的基础词干，hurdl- 是加 -er/-ing 时去掉词尾 e 的形式。历史 hyrdel 的小称关系通过 source.note 保留；不要把 -dle 当成现代后缀或把 hurdle 与 hurtle 合并。

meaning.en: reverse an action; remove or release

source.note: The reversative verbal prefix is historically distinct from negative un-. Compare untangle = undo tangling. Source: https://www.etymonline.com/word/un- (un- 2).

learning.coreImage: 把已经发生的动作反过来做，恢复或释放。
learning.notes: untangle 中为反向动作；untangled 作形容词时也可能有“不缠结”的否定读法。此条与 root:un 的单纯否定义分开。
